description: This file defines various structures, enums, and classes used throughout the libGLESv2 and libANGLE projects, including geometric types, rendering states, sampler states, and utility functions for type casting and resource management.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: Represents a rectangular area with position and size, with methods for flipping, removing reversals, and checking enclosure.

classes.name: Offset
classes.description: Represents a 3D offset with x, y, z components.

classes.name: Extents
classes.description: Represents dimensions in width, height, and depth.

classes.name: Box
classes.description: Represents a 3D box with position and size, convertible to a Rectangle.

classes.name: RasterizerState
classes.description: Holds rasterization state parameters such as culling, polygon offset, and rasterizer discard.

classes.name: BlendState
classes.description: Holds blending state parameters including blend factors, equations, and color masks.

classes.name: DepthStencilState
classes.description: Holds depth and stencil testing state parameters.

classes.name: SamplerState
classes.description: Encapsulates sampler parameters like filters, wrap modes, anisotropy, LOD, and comparison modes.

classes.name: DrawArraysIndirectCommand
classes.description: Structure for indirect draw command with count, instance count, first, and base instance.

classes.name: DrawElementsIndirectCommand
classes.description: Structure for indirect indexed draw command with count, primCount, first index, base vertex, and base instance.

classes.name: ImageUnit
classes.description: Represents an image unit with associated texture, level, layering, access, and format.

classes.name: PixelStoreStateBase
classes.description: Base class for pixel storage state, including alignment, row length, skip parameters, and image height.

classes.name: PixelUnpackState
classes.description: Pixel unpack state, derived from PixelStoreStateBase.

classes.name: PixelPackState
classes.description: Pixel pack state, derived from PixelStoreStateBase, with additional reverse row order flag.

classes.name: ComponentType
classes.description: Enumeration of component data types used in graphics buffers.
